Based on the provided web page content:

**Paper Title:**
"Towards Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-SQL Semantic Parsing with Formulaic Knowledge"

**Abstract:**
The research addresses knowledge-intensive text-to-SQL conversion by introducing a new benchmark called KnowSQL and proposing the ReGrouP framework. Rather than collecting additional training examples, the authors represent domain knowledge formulaically through a knowledge bank, achieving a "28.2% improvement overall on KnowSQL."

**Datasets Used:**
The paper introduces **KnowSQL**, described as "a new benchmark KnowSQL consisting of domain-specific questions covering various domains."

**Code Link:**
The web page content does not provide a code repository link or GitHub URL for this work. Only the paper's DOI (10.18653/v1/2022.emnlp-main.350) and PDF link are available.
